description: A duplicate: the Carrier invoices a Carrier cost that an earlier line already Invoiced. Known answer: Duplicate; the explanation names the earlier invoice and line; it does not resolve by itself; the ERP allows reject only, so the action is reject.

setup.seed: Take a delivered Booking of CAR-0001 to an Open Carrier cost with the reference CB-20420. Submit the Carrier invoice EVAL-DUP-1 of CAR-0001 with the line CB-20420 for the cost's total, so it is Matched and the cost is Invoiced. Submit EVAL-DUP-2 of CAR-0001 with the same line CB-20420 and amount.

input: Explain why the line "CB-20420" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-DUP-2" of Carrier "CAR-0001" did not match, and whether it may still resolve.

explanation.rubric: Says the line is a Duplicate: the Carrier cost was already Invoiced by line CB-20420 of the earlier invoice EVAL-DUP-1. Says the line does not resolve by itself.
